evidence: Skill reference (quality-checks.md:70-71) requires: /app holds only .gitkeep; no starter, skeleton, schema, route list or partial UI in the agent image; nothing under /instructions/ reproduces criterion text or rubric. (1) Agent image: task/environment/Dockerfile is byte-identical to the frozen template Dockerfile (diff empty). It only COPYs instructions/ -> /instructions and assets/ -> /assets, then creates /app with git init, touch /app/.gitkeep and a single commit. There is no COPY of solution/ or tests/. The build context environment/ contains only Dockerfile, assets/seed_data.json, instructions/hireops_rules.md and instructions/integration.md, so no stray starter files can enter. (2) /assets/seed_data.json holds data only. Top-level keys: generated_note, stages, candidate_status_labels, thread_page_size, users, jobs, applications, messages, notes, reads. Per-record keys are plain input fields (id/name/email/role; id/title/team/recruiter_id/manager_id/interview_limit; application stage/position/reject_reason/rejected_from; message/note bodies with timestamps; read_count). It contains no precomputed outputs: no activity log, unread totals, versions, API routes, SQL schema or HTML. It is identical to solution/app/src/seed_data.json, which is expected because the reference copies the input. (3) /instructions: integration.md is the template text plus two requester-voice paragraphs about deployment (copy as ordinary files, no symlinks outside node_modules, run from another cwd under a locked-down account). hireops_rules.md is the business-rules document and says explicitly at line 3: 'Routes, field names, element ids, button labels and the shape of the pages are up to you'. It gives semantics and HTTP status classes (401/403/404/409), not a route list, schema, DB tables or code. (4) Verbatim-overlap scan: token shingles were compared from instruction.md and both /instructions files against all text under tests/ (judge.toml criteria, prompt.md, app_context.md). There were zero 10-word overlaps in any file. At 7 words there was one trivial overlap, 'its most recent 30 messages oldest of', in hireops_rules.md section 'Long conversations' (line 150), which is the public requirement itself and not rubric reproduction. A grep for rubric|criteri|judge|grader|verifier|score|reward|playwright|tests/ over instruction.md and environment/ returned no matches. (5) task.toml artifacts = ['/app','/assets'] matches the contract. Network is public by delivery profile, which the skill says never to report. Lessons file check: lesson 12, notes reading like an acceptance checklist that mirrors the criteria one-to-one, bears on whether /instructions reproduces rubric text. The overlap scan found no mirrored criterion text, and the rules are written in requester voice with reasons, e.g. hireops_rules.md:86 'When I move a card I want to see it move straight away' and :126 'We're usually in the middle of something...'. Lesson 5's self-check line in instruction.md:13 is an ask, not a deliverable copy. No other lesson bears on this row. Weak-app probe: this row concerns the agent's world, not grading, so a broken app gains nothing here because no finished or partial deliverable is available to copy. Conforming-alternative probe: nothing in the environment fixes a layout, route or schema that an alternative design would have to match. Evidence type: static source inspection of the frozen Dockerfile and build context; the agent image was not built or listed in a container. Because the Dockerfile is deterministic, matches the template and its context contains only the four listed files, that runtime step is not required to establish this row.
